notes.title: FEELS - Chapter 2 Update
notes.notes:
[h3]Chapter 2 is out! You can update your game to access the new content.[/h3]

This update includes: 

- 23 new Locations 
- 38 new Enemies 
- 12 new NPCs
- 62 new Items
- 55 new Abilities
[b]- 18 new Endings[/b]
- A lot of new quests.
[b]- A new game mode.[/b]
- Many bug fixes and a great stability upgrade.

The new game mode can be unlocked after 6 endings have been found.

Your Chapter 1 saves are kept inside the original save folder. You can always return to Chapter 1 by selecting feels > properties > betas > chapter_1 in your steam library.

I really enjoyed making this new chapter with the help of our talented composer Michael and our great artist Tilik.

[b]Thanks to everyone who played / will play FEELS and good luck in finding all the endings![/b]

Cheers,
Antoine

notes.title: Chapter 2 will be out very soon; what to know:
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, and thank you for your patience. The second chapter of FEELS is in its final testing phase and will be out in the following days. Here are a few points you might want to know:


-	You will need to update your game to play chapter two.

-	There is a total of 19 endings, one of which is shared with the preceding chapter.

-	A new game mode can be unlocked after 6 endings have been found. It focuses more on combat and leveling.

-	Old saves won’t be compatible with chapter two since many paths have changed.

-	Achievements from chapter one can’t be unlocked in chapter two. You can still play chapter one by selecting feels > properties > betas > chapter_1 in your steam library.  


Thanks to everyone who played chapter one, and I really hope you will enjoy playing chapter two. 
I wish you luck finding all the endings; feel free to ask any question on the subreddit /r/feelsthegame.

Cheers,
Antoine

notes.title: FEELS' development has slowed down, but chapter 2 is coming
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,


I'm sorry to announce that due to the game's lack of funding, development will take longer than expected. 

However, it is not abandoned and I've continued to work on FEELS.

Chapter 2 should be completed in the following months. It will bring a lot of new content and stability upgrades.


With Best Regards,

Antoine
